column1: For full-year 2024, what was the aggregate capital returned to common shareholders (share repurchases plus common dividends including specials) across the six MI cohort issuers?,"Approximately $3.67 billion was returned to common shareholders across the cohort in FY2024. Per-issuer: MGIC $697M ($566.6M repurchases + $130.5M dividends), Radian $377M ($224M + $153M), Essent $221M ($102.7M + $118.0M), NMI $98M (repurchases only — NMI does not pay a common dividend), Enact $356M ($244M + $112M), and Arch ~$1.92B (dominated by a $1.9B / $5-per-share special dividend in December 2024 plus $24M of repurchases).","Here is the aggregate capital returned to common shareholders for full-year 2024 across the six MI cohort issuers:

The six-issuer aggregate capital returned to common shareholders in FY2024 was **~$3.64 billion**. Arch Capital alone accounted for over half of the total ($1.89B), driven almost entirely by its $1.9B special dividend paid in December 2024. Excluding Arch's special dividend, the aggregate would have been ~$1.75B, with MTG ($697M) and RDN ($377M) as the next largest returners.
